# Lucide icon assets

USBArc includes four Lucide SVGs from the official repository, downloaded from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/` on 2026-10-15. Their outline paths are unchanged; `currentColor` was replaced with USBArc's blue accent for consistent media rendering.

- `lucide_hard_drive.svg` — `hard-drive.svg`, used for USB mass storage.
- `lucide_cable.svg` — `cable.svg`, used for serial, CDC, and UART adapters.
- `lucide_cpu.svg` — `cpu.svg`, used for J-Link, ST-Link, and debug probes.
- `lucide_plug.svg` — `plug.svg`, used for other USB devices.

The original Lucide license is preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE). Lucide icons are provided under the ISC License, with listed Feather-derived icons under MIT.
